sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 180. Physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 40 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases light elemental attack by 6 for 60 seconds.
Only [Five Sacred Beasts] Koryu can be used as Unlocking Potential material
